sentences.text:
This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 (Section 439 of the Cr.P.C., 1973) for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.255/2024, dated 14.06.2024 registered at Police Station- Hanumana, District-Mauganj (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376, 450 of IPC and Section 3/4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act,
2012.

entities.text:
Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act,
2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Applicant is in detention since 14.06.2024.

2 Applicant's first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed vide order dated 04.11.2024 passed in M.Cr.C. No.34747 of 2024 with liberty to revive the prayer for grant of bail after recording of prosecutrix's evidence before the Trial Court.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:12017 2 MCRC-6564-2025 3

As per the prosecution story, on 14.06.2024, 16 years old prosecutrix submitted an application in writing alleging that on 12.06.2024 at around 09:00 am, she had gone to place dung-cakes in the house of Shekhan Shiv Prasad Prajapati @ Munna vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84687823/
1

entities.text: Shekhan Shiv Prasad Prajapati @ Munna vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Kushwaha (Kachhi) and when she was placing dung-cakes, Munna Prajapati (present applicant)
came and committed rape upon her.
FIR was registered.
After investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
4 Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is in detention since 14.06.2024.
He has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has no criminal background.
It is contended that on account of old enmity and on account of some land dispute, applicant has been falsely implicated.
It is submitted that DNA report has been received and same is inconclusive.
On the aforesaid pretext, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail, pending the trial.
5 . On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.
6 . DNA report has been received and same is inconclusive.
Proseuctrix has already been examined before the Trial Court and now, there is no possibility of influencing of prosecution witnesses and tampering with prosecution evidence.

Therefore, having taken into consideration all the facts &
circumstance of the case including the submissions put-forth by learned counsel for the applicant,
but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.

Consequently, this bail application under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 (Section 439 of CrPC, 1973) for grant of bail NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:12017 3 MCRC-6564-2025 filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant - Shiv Prasad Prajapati @ Munna be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS, 2023 [Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C., 1973].
8 . This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE @shish Shiv Prasad Prajapati @ Munna vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84687823/
